title: 2021 AMC12B 8
statement: Three equally spaced parallel lines intersect a circle, creating three chords of lengths \(38,\) \(38,\) and \(34.\) What is the distance between two adjacent parallel lines?

solutions.text:
Place the center at height \(0.\) Two equal chords lie at equal distances from the center, so the three equally spaced lines are at heights \(-\tfrac{d}{2},\tfrac{d}{2},\tfrac{3d}{2},\) with the two \(38\)-chords at \(\pm\tfrac{d}{2}\) and the \(34\)-chord at \(\tfrac{3d}{2}.\)

Half-chord relations give \(r^2-\left(\tfrac{d}{2}\right)^2=19^2\) and \(r^2-\left(\tfrac{3d}{2}\right)^2=17^2.\)

Subtracting, \(2d^2=19^2-17^2=72,\) so \(d^2=36\) and \(d=6.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Equal chords are equidistant from the center, so the two \(38\) chords sit at heights \(\pm\tfrac{d}{2}\)
